In a romanticized painting by George William Joy, this man is depicted at the top of a staircase staring down towards soldiers racing at him. After Gladstone reluctantly sent him to evacuate troops down the Nile River, he was slain while defending Khartoum against the forces of the Mahdi. Earlier, he had led the "Ever- Victorious Army" which fought against the army of Hong Xiuquan. For 10 points, name this British military officer whose acts in putting down the Taiping Rebellion earned him the nickname "Chinese."
